key_insight: Selective auditing can reduce expert review while provably keeping the fraction of AI errors that go unaudited below a user-defined threshold.
engineering_relevance: The framework supports AI decision pipelines that use confidence scores to decide when expert review is needed.
method: Receive an AI decision and a confidence score, potentially from separate models.
Choose automatic acceptance or expert review using online constrained optimization.
Apply error-control algorithms, including one that asymptotically achieves the optimal auditing rate for adversarial and i.i.d. streams.
evidence_signal: Experiments on harmful-request screening, qualitative text annotation, and data labeling report valid error control with substantially less human auditing than baselines.
watch_item: Asymptotically optimal auditing does not ensure low review demand immediately; deployment also depends on dependable expert review capacity.
paper_title: Reliable AI-Assisted Decisions via Selective Auditing
